$meta.colorFormat: sRGB #RRGGBBAA, channel-clipped. Alpha colors are not pre-composited.
$meta.appearance: Default appearance: theme preference `system` (no theme preset applied), contrast 100. `color` is the <html> scope; `colorSidebar` lists what an element with [data-app-sidebar] computes differently.
$meta.desktopBreakpoint: Window min width is 840px, so Tailwind `sm:` (>=640px) and `md:` (>=768px) values always apply on desktop.
carriedOver: layout (beyond topbarHeightPx and titlebar control sizes)
terminal.ansi (16 ANSI colors; terminal now renders via Ghostty)
status pr-closed / error (no longer in Sidebar.logic.ts)

edgeBevel.note: ::before inset 0, radius r-1, box-shadow. Light: 1px line on the bottom border row. Dark: 1px line on the top border row.

sans.family: system UI (-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif)
sans.note: Settings -> Appearance can prepend a custom family; the default renders SF Pro on macOS.

mono.note: Runtime default (appearanceFonts.ts DEFAULT_CODE_FONT_STACK); index.css's --font-mono also starts with ui-monospace.

noiseOverlay.placement: Behind content: body background-image and the surface-grain utility on surfaces that float over the body (index.css --surface-grain).

gpuiComponentTheme.name: T3 Code
gpuiComponentTheme.author: generated from the t3code fork tokens
